items.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive with Google brought learners together in a no-cost course to build and deploy the next frontier of AI.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。

items.title: Ori Eval: Find the Best Model for What You're Building — OpenRouter Blog
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：Ori Eval runs your agent on your own prompts, asserts on the tools it called, and grades answers with an LLM judge. Find the best model for what you're building.
